# InsiderEdgePro

> InsiderEdgePro is a free public tracker for insider trading disclosures. It aggregates official government filings — SEC Form 4 in the United States, STOCK Act Periodic Transaction Reports from the U.S. Congress, and SEDI insider reports in Canada — into searchable, real-time feeds with cluster buy detection, per-politician portfolios, and performance tracking.

All data on this site is reorganized from public government records. Nothing here is financial advice, and inclusion of any person or trade does not imply illegal insider trading or wrongdoing.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://insideredgepro.github.io/): Overview, latest filings, live cluster buy signals
- [US Insider Trades](https://insideredgepro.github.io/us.html): Live SEC Form 4 open-market purchase feed
- [Congress Trades](https://insideredgepro.github.io/congress.html): STOCK Act disclosures with portfolios, stock sentiment, and performance
- [Canada Insider Trades](https://insideredgepro.github.io/canada.html): SEDI filings for TSX and TSX-V issuers
- [Performance](https://insideredgepro.github.io/performance.html): Return tracking of disclosed insider buys
- [Nancy Pelosi Stock Tracker](https://insideredgepro.github.io/nancy-pelosi-stock-tracker.html): Dedicated tracker page

## Reference

- [About](https://insideredgepro.github.io/about.html): What the project does and where the data comes from
- [Methodology](https://insideredgepro.github.io/methodology.html): How trades are parsed, filtered, and flagged
- [Terms](https://insideredgepro.github.io/terms.html): Terms of use

## Data

- [Latest US trades (JSON)](https://insideredgepro.github.io/data/latest.json): Most recent SEC Form 4 purchases
- [Recent Congress trades (JSON)](https://insideredgepro.github.io/data/trades-recent.json): Latest STOCK Act disclosures
- [Latest Canada trades (JSON)](https://insideredgepro.github.io/data/canada_latest.json): Latest SEDI filings

Feeds refresh automatically throughout the trading day.
